34769: Despite their age difference, Lesbian couple Olivia and Alex are very much in love. But as the question of pregnancy rears its head and their neighbour John befriends them, they both start making some truly disastrous decisions.
Two's company, three's a total nightmare.

YOU feel it until you can't feel anything at all!

37073: In 1994, in the picturesque village of Dimda on the Telangana border, this is the gripping story of Satyam-a kind-hearted farmer's son. His love for Saritha, the village sarpanch's niece, sparks jealousy and rage, leading to betrayal.

When 10,000 Biceps go around 5,000 Bikinis... you KNOW what's gonna happen!

He knew he could be a champion. They knew he could be much more.
37841: The two 'most wanted' cowboys in the New Mexico territory ride into Corazon for one last job - to rob the ruthless town boss.
Old West. New Soul. Big Payback.

38353: A retired guitarist avoids suffering his mid-life crisis by spending time with her daughter and teaching kids how to play the guitar. Yet it's only until he makes a new girlfriend that he finally comes up with a solution to his crisis.
38609: After a cab driver is found dead, a young pub employee is framed for the murder and is sent to jail for 8 years. When he comes out on parole, a young lawyer takes up the case to prove his innocence.
38865: Santa Claus finds his sleigh stuck in the sand on a Florida beach only days before Christmas Eve.
The amazing story of Santa in big trouble... And his exciting rescue by the daring ice cream bunny ... It's breath-taking, fun for all.

39633: The semi-autobiographical film was written by Mahesh Bhatt about his extramarital relationship with actress Parveen Babi.

Entry is for the theatrically released extended version, not the segment from the Eros anthology.
40145: Spain, 1982. 40401: After the death of his older brother, Guiseppe "the guppy" Calzone becomes head of the Calzone Mob family. Some wise guys aren't so smart!
40657: A young woman's happy life with her father takes a downward turn when she begins to suspect that he's a kidnapper.
40913: Liza falls in love with one of her father's employees. Her socialistic ideas about employment drive her to collide with her father and the sociopolitical status of the time.
41169: A business mogul runs into his old small town girlfriend while she is visiting the big city only to find out that they had a child together that he was unaware of.
Nothing is what it seems, and the truth will be revealed.
41425: Fatima, an Algerian-born woman who now lives in France with her two teenage daughters, with whom she is barely able to communicate.
41681: In an impoverished neighborhood, the son of a swordsman falls in love with the daughter of a wedding singer — a taboo match in a traditional society.

42193: Tommaso goes incredible lengths to win back the love of his former girlfriend Cecilia, but sometimes things change in the most unexpected way.
42449: An architect engages in conflict with an activist who lives in a dangerous complex the architect designed.
Sometimes you need to tear down to build up.

43217: A U.S. Marshal seeking justice for his brother's murder defends a small town from a corrupt Mayor and his henchmen with intents to revive the civil war.

THIS WAS THE NIGHT WHEN THE LAW TURNED LAWLESS...to win back the justice a town had betrayed!
44241: Fresh out of prison, a seasoned poker hustler finds himself teaching the trade to a young cab driver chasing his first big win.
44497: When Standa is released from jail, he feels a brighter future is about to take hold. Instead, his bad luck grows, thanks to a new acquaintance.
44753: A Nigerian couple living in Brooklyn are having trouble conceiving a child - a problem that defies cultural expectations and leads to a shocking decision that could either save or destroy them.
45009: Soldiers in a rural English town are being brutally murdered by an unknown creature. Two nearby sisters realise they might understand what's happening.
45265: The Venetian traveler Marco Polo meets Kublai Khan and foils a plotter with fireworks in medieval China.
HE Came, HE Saw, HE Conquered

At 19, they gave him the streets. Tonight, they're going to take them back.

47313: A homicide detective realizes that the brutal murders committed by a mysterious serial killer he's after have something to do with the late husband of a beautiful widow.
He won't quit until he gets the final piece.

What future has this sinking city?
47825: A beautiful sexy DJ is forced to run when she stumbles on a stash of cash. Can she keep the money, conquer her demons, AND get the girl?

The end of the world as we knew it.

Runaway hilarity when Don Knotts runs down City Hall...in search of the buried secrets of a gang of crooked politicians. The movie the entire family will enjoy!
48593: A story of a family seeking shelter in a neighbor’s bunker while the American economy is in collapse and the nation under martial law. There they find the danger inside is potentially greater than the danger outside.

Behind Bars No One Can Hear You Scream!

A spy is hiding among them.

IT HAS A TASTE FOR FOUL MEN.

Take a picture. Take a life.

There is a room for rent in the Hollywood Hills, and the tenants are paying in blood!

Sometimes you win. Sometimes you learn.
